command:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
name='diag_t02_raw10_smoke_plan_01';run='t02_rejected_raw_smoke_01'
p=Path('results/t02_export_first6_01_retry2_u0000.json');r=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert r['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and r['metrics']['pairs'][0]['status']=='exported'
cfg=r['config']
command=['python3','-u','-m','src.tools.t02_export','--name',run,'--source',cfg['source'],'--pair-id',cfg['pair_id'][0],'--pair-file',cfg['pair_file'],'--timeout-seconds','600','--pair-timeout-seconds','390','--gate-timeout-seconds','180','--sample-rejected-raw']
out=Path('configs/t02_raw10_smoke_01.json');out.write_text(json.dumps({'command':command,'scope':'Engineering repeat of one original cached-qualified pair; not a new training-pool member','source_export':{'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'PBS_walltime':'00:10:30'},indent=2)+'\n');out.chmod(0o444)
metrics={'command':command,'configuration':{'file':str(out),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'validated_original_export_identity':True,'scientific_rejection_coverage_not_promised':True,'GPU_submitted':False}
Path('results',name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metrics':metrics,'config':{'name':name,'scope':'Single-pair future-retention engineering smoke'}},indent=2));print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics),flush=True)
